product_from_film: Sponge gives agents financial accounts and lets service owners charge agents for API use.
explains_well: The same four requests fail before the account appears and gain payment marks afterwards.
unclear: The film does not follow one paid request through to a delivered result and matching receipt.
scenario: An agent fails to purchase, trade, transfer and call a paid API, then gains an account; a service owner prices an endpoint and sees revenue.
product_clear_basis: Give your agents financial accounts appears beside an account card at 16s.

scenes.action: A blue orb greets the viewer. Four request bubbles accumulate around it: headphones, a trade, agent payment and an API call. Refusal messages appear and the orb becomes red.
scenes.design: White field, small chat bubbles and glossy colored orb.
scenes.purpose: Make financial inability concrete through repeated tasks.
scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 0–13s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

scenes.action: Sponge is named. A dark financial card appears, then the orb returns blue. The same request bubbles gain blue payment marks while the card balance falls.
scenes.design: Black account card, blue orb and repeated task labels.
scenes.purpose: Present the account as the missing capability.
scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 13–22s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

scenes.action: A gateway panel accepts an endpoint, shows a $0.05 price and a Monetize control, then a setup state.
scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 22–26s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

scenes.action: A dashboard chart rises to $50 with agent rows. Captions say any endpoint can become a paid service and agents pay without human interaction.

scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 26–33s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

categories.finding: Failed requests → funded agent → priced endpoint → revenue → identity.
A small blue orb and greeting appear on a mostly empty white field. The financial problem arrives with later requests.
Agent builders and API/service owners are the two implied audiences. The account role is clear at 16s and gateway role at 23s.
Orb color changes, task bubbles accumulate, the balance falls and the chart grows across sampled states. Exact paths/easing are unverified.
The repeated request layout connects before and after; the shift to the gateway changes audience and task.
Glossy blue/red orb contrasts with sparse white layouts and dark financial card.
Task bubbles explain failures and success marks; gateway captions explain the second feature. Small row text is less prominent than totals.
Voice delivery is unverified.

Effects and their sources are unverified.

categories.finding: Visible requests, refusals, account caption and gateway form carry the broad proposition without verified audio.
The orb stays central while requests surround it; later the account and green chart become focal objects.
Four failures occupy 13s, followed by two product roles in about 20s. One complete transaction would clarify the connection.
The opening inability is answered with the same requests and decreasing balance, but the requested outputs are not shown.
Red refusals give way to blue activity and green revenue, suggesting relief and progress; audience response is unmeasured.
The repeated orb and request labels make the before/after easy to trace. The seller dashboard lacks a matching request identifier.
Balances, payment marks and revenue are illustrative film evidence, not verified transactions or proof of autonomous operation.
Four concrete financial failures and the two-sided gateway story provide more specificity than the broad infrastructure slogan.
Connect one purchase to its result.
categories.experiment: Carry the scrape request through a priced call, returned data and a matching seller receipt.
